productionCause: Confirmed running image 2076769f1ee1 from original 0.3.0 export predates the admin fixes.

checks: Release 0.3.1 is identifiable through health, response header and footer; authenticated CSS is not cached; no-JS SSR fills the viewport.
The upgraded XSection, header and main fill the viewport from 320 to 3840px without horizontal overflow.
An approval produces one genuine XToast after the confirmed save, keeps focus in the form, expires, and is not resurrected by unrelated renders.
Source blocking and repeated approval show fresh action-specific notices; close returns keyboard focus to the initiating control without scrolling.
Rejected changes produce a persistent accessible error toast and no success message; feedback stays inside the mobile viewport and is dismissible.
Reduced-motion preference is respected by the native component; the test source is disabled again.
Capability help opens from the keyboard, explains catalog vs. approval and provides all IDs plus a concrete example.
Large source list and long names do not clip; selecting a deep entry preserves document and list scroll without reload.
Category and case-insensitive name filters compose, survive source selection, policy save and refresh; no source was approved by this test.
Empty results provide recovery instead of an unrelated policy; reset, back/forward, IT and social-media filters work.
320/390/720px layouts and light/dark help stay within viewport; search input retains at least 16px.
Help, composed filters and source selection work with JavaScript disabled; safe POST forms and native logout remain intact.
All six engine policies persisted through real RMT actions; source navigation resumes without document reload.
CSRF and stale revisions rejected by HTTP service boundary.
Routing mode commands update canonical state and audit.
Mobile and 200%-equivalent layout remain within viewport; input size >=16px.
Three delayed engines paint incrementally, append without moving existing results, and preserve the document.
A superseded query cannot commit into the new result surface.
News mode and browser back navigation work.
Direct SSR search remains useful without JavaScript.
Viewer cannot mutate through UI or direct service requests.
Operator can schedule a budgeted probe and drain a source, but cannot approve policies.
